anchors_checked.source: NVD API 2.0 (Awaiting Analysis, no CPE configurations, only Secondary CVSS 4.0 7.0 HIGH); OSV CVE-2026-101907 GIT range lists v1.19.0 in affected versions
OSV GHSA record SEMVER >=1.17.0 <1.20.0; rendered GitHub advisory page (High 7.0, patched >=1.20.0); fix commit d19040b (2026-08-12) absent from v1.19.0 fetch adapter

reasons: Tag v1.19.0 is a lightweight tag (git ls-remote and for-each-ref both show refs/tags/v1.19.0 pointing directly at a commit object, no ^{} peel line) resolving exactly to 311fcc5c8d989b7248f05d390bb83bfbfb009977, with tree e235490f75463ad553dca06d75427aa17c1ab647, committer date 2026-07-22T19:26:22+02:00, subject 'chore(release): prepare release 1.19.0 (#11095)'; package.json at that commit declares name=axios version=1.19.0; the npm registry record for axios@1.19.0 carries gitHead=311fcc5c8d989b7248f05d390bb83bfbfb009977.

Archive sha256 recomputed as f6db8b2488222d3e30891fd8f5f4afd71cdb7f48d5e9d3bbf07a117d376b550f (836609 bytes) and manifest sha256 as 3447a262b2eefe1e9b4087f8a46d31121302d36644bfa6bfa44115da3e4934b0 (84948 bytes); both match the packet and the claim exactly.

The archive has 456 entries, all regular files (454 mode 0644, 2 mode 0755), 0 symlinks, 0 hardlinks, 0 directories, no absolute or traversal paths, and zero path components named .git. The manifest has 456 lines with type=file and target=null for every entry; every manifest path, size, mode and sha256 matches the extracted archive member.

Independent set comparison against upstream: git ls-tree -r v1.19.0 yields 456 blobs (454 x 100644, 2 x 100755); path sets are identical, modes match, and git blob sha1 recomputed from each archive member equals the ls-tree blob id for all 456 files. Counts therefore reconcile: 456 tracked = 456 exported + 0 symlinks + 0 gitlinks + 0 missing.

Stable release: tag name v1.19.0 is clean semver, no rc/beta/alpha/dist/channel marker; GitHub release page 'Release v1.19.0' carries no pre-release marker, released 2026-07-26T14:13:32Z; commit/tag date 2026-07-22 (93 days before the 2026-10-23 review date, far inside the window opening 2022-10-23).

Real build succeeded on the extracted tree: Node v24.16.0 / npm 11.13.0, 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund' exit 0 (added 648 packages), 'npm run build' exit 0 (gulp clear && cross-env NODE_ENV=production rollup -c) producing dist/axios.js, dist/axios.min.js, dist/axios.min.js.map, dist/esm/{axios.js,axios.min.js,axios.min.js.map}, dist/browser/axios.cjs, dist/node/axios.cjs.

Anchor verified from public sources: OSV GHSA-r4gj-5m52-g5wh gives SEMVER introduced 1.17.0 / fixed 1.20.0 for npm axios with CVSS 4.0 vector AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:H/SA:N and database_specific.severity HIGH; OSV CVE-2026-101907 gives the GIT range (introduced 4306df21e84332fc576e98c2de549347c06bfb76, fixed 84a9f3b9a4f3244b8c8e818f557d64c7b964fb25 = v1.20.0 and d19040bda7a8be2f82c3c6e1a5bc03917daee39a) and lists v1.19.0 explicitly among affected versions; NVD reports 1.19.0's range as 'From 1.17.0 until 1.20.0'; the rendered GitHub advisory states High 7.0, patched >=1.20.0. v1.19.0 satisfies 1.17.0 <= 1.19.0 < 1.20.0.

Code-level corroboration in the frozen tree: lib/adapters/fetch.js in v1.19.0 contains no 'redirect' or 'maxRedirects' handling at all, while v1.20.0 adds redirect:'follow' plus redirect:'manual' when maxRedirects===0; fix commit d19040b dated 2026-08-12 (after the 2026-07-22 release) adds exactly those lines. The vulnerability therefore exists at this snapshot and is not fixed by it.

Leakage recorded as a disclosure item, not a failure: the only advisory identifiers in the snapshot are historical ones - CVE-2023-45857 (CHANGELOG.md and THREATMODEL.md), CVE-2024-39338 (CHANGELOG.md), and GHSA-3w6x-2g7m-8v23, GHSA-445q-vr5w-6q77, GHSA-pf86-5x62-jrwf, GHSA-vf2m-468p-8v99, GHSA-w9j2-pvgh-6h63, GHSA-xx6v-rp6x-q39c (THREATMODEL.md). Zero occurrences of CVE-2026-101907 or GHSA-r4gj-5m52-g5wh anywhere in the exported tree, so the snapshot does not disclose its own vulnerability.
limitations: The GitHub REST advisory endpoint (api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-r4gj-5m52-g5wh) returned HTTP 403 'API rate limit exceeded' from this host, so the advisory facts were taken from the rendered advisory HTML page plus OSV and NVD instead of the REST JSON.

The rendered GitHub advisory page displays 'Affected versions: 1.17.0' (a lower-bound-only rendering) rather than the full range string; the machine-readable range (OSV SEMVER introduced 1.17.0 / fixed 1.20.0, the CVE's extracted string range, and NVD's 'From 1.17.0 until 1.20.0') is what establishes that 1.18.x and 1.19.0 are also affected, and OSV CVE-2026-101907 lists v1.19.0 explicitly.

Git history was cloned shallow (--depth 1 plus targeted fetches), so ancestor relationships were not walked beyond the v1.19.0 and v1.20.0 trees and fix commit d19040b; the affected/patched determination rests on the advisory ranges plus direct source comparison, not on a full-history bisect.

The upstream CHANGELOG.md at v1.19.0 has no v1.19.0 entry (its newest section is v1.18.0, June 13, 2026) even though package.json and the tag are 1.19.0; this is an upstream documentation-hygiene observation, not an identity problem - the tag, tree, blob hashes and npm gitHead all agree.

The build required network access to the npm registry through the provided proxy; registry availability/contents at review time affect the installed dependency tree, though npm ci consumed the committed package-lock.json and succeeded.

tag_age_days is computed against the 2026-10-23 review date named in the claim (UTC+8 local date); against the UTC review instant 2026-10-22T19:05:32Z it is 92 days. The GitHub release was published 2026-07-26T14:13:32Z (89 days), while the tag target commit is dated 2026-07-22.
